label: Every cause of a thing's being is a CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (sustaining reading of the tenseless cause of being): in every history of the model, if c causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) and x is present at some moment, then c gives x being at every moment at which x is present (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2). The time-indexed image of q.104 a.1 (direct per se conservation of esse, definition 56989bd0; the air is not lit 'even for a moment' when the sun ceases), without its dependence clause. Contested by existential inertia (Schmid 2021, read): persisting things need no concurrent sustaining cause. Its rival reading, that every cause of being is CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 originating, holds in Control part 1.
